_comment: Golden/regression snapshot cases for scripts/parse_entries.py, per docs/pipeline-strategy.md strategy #8. Each case pins down a specific behavior that was manually verified once (see ISSUES.md / conversation history) -- run scripts/check_golden.py after any change to parse_entries.py to catch silent regressions before a full re-run. 'checks' fields are asserted with the semantics documented in check_golden.py.

cases.name: Bd01 redirect with multi-word target (only first word captured, per structure-notes.md §7's own stated convention)

Bd01 split-headword-across-two-markers merge (subject article) -- guards the line-anchored-regex bug (marker mid-line was invisible, leaked raw HTML comment into body_text) and the false-merge-of-short-redirects regression (wrong threshold merged 34 genuine redirects into their next entry)
Bd01 multi-page subject article -- guards the page-break rejoin bug (hyphenated word split across a page, e.g. 'Steue-'/'rung', got a spurious paragraph break instead of joining)
Bd04 false-positive 'Werke:' inside a Literatur citation title -- guards the karma/K. regression (a cited edition titled 'K., Werke: Fragmente...' was wrongly read as this entry's own Werke: section)
Bd07 end-to-end: ties together the MT-Symbol arrow CMap fix (ISSUES.md issue #5) and the parser's per-volume xref_arrow config -- only correct if both agree

aggregate_checks.name: Bd01 redirect count stays at 58 -- guards the false-merge regression from collapsing short redirects into their next entry. 52 while headwords were stored as raw anchors; 58 now that they are the typesetter own bold run, which tags redirects the anchor form missed.
Bd01 split_headword_merged count stays at exactly 2
